text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"oer_ni_fe_co_screen_batch_12","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before new batch"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"standard NiFeCo-Sn film, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":"1173K","duration":7200,"substrate":"FTO"},"comment":"routine anneal per SOP; temperature given in kelvin, duration in seconds","label":"standard_anneal_profile"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"re-init after anneal"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"baseline chronopotentiometry at default rate"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"duration":3600},"comment":"short stability check"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"ingest batch 12 results"}]}
